p: Bridge Place sits in the middle of Worksop town centre, close to the main shopping streets. This Admiral is an adult gaming centre, which means over 18s only.

Worksop calls itself the Gateway to the Dukeries, after the great estates that surround it, and the best known, Clumber Park, is a short drive away. Run by the National Trust, it has a huge lake, woodland, a walled kitchen garden and cycle hire. In town, Worksop Priory and its medieval gatehouse are well worth a look, and Mr Straw's House, a 1920s-frozen family home also cared for by the National Trust, is a quirky little treat. The Chesterfield Canal runs right through the centre, too.
